strategies.S0_no_intervention: Run each task at its original preferred start.
strategies.S1_rule_based: Use the scheduling service deterministic greedy reference against announced tariff periods.
strategies.S2_forecast_milp: Use the service MILP with noisy day-ahead realized-price estimates.
strategies.oracle: Use the same MILP with realized interval prices (perfect information).

synthetic_assumptions.household_profiles: Generated baseline shapes; no customer data.
synthetic_assumptions.tariff: Synthetic AUD energy-only TOU profile; no supply or demand charges.
synthetic_assumptions.appliance_profiles: Fixed power and duration task assumptions in source.
